# Brasilien förbjuder I-gaming – USA avslår Irans fredsplan

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon covers rising global bond yields (US 10-year at 5.2%, Korea and Japan at multi-year highs), Brent oil above $107 after the US rejected Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz, and a thin, AI-driven equity rally the hosts call fragile. The main stock story is Brazil's proposed ban on online betting and casinos. It hits Swedish-listed gaming names hard: Better Collective has already cut its guidance, and Evolution, Betsson and Kambi are exposed. The hosts also say real estate remains 'in the freezer' because of higher rates, and that US-China tariff cuts could hurt Electrolux and forestry companies.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ BETCO — Better Collective | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Big write-down and guidance cut after Brazil's online gambling ban; Brazil was ~40% of profit.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call Brazil a highly profitable market for Better Collective: ~13% of revenue but ~40% of earnings. The company has already written down assets and cut its outlook sharply. Deposits stop within days and the long-term effects are 'decisive', which makes the ban a structural blow to earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Brazil ban is reversed after the election
- if Brazil re-regulates instead of banning

> *"Better Collective är ute idag tydligt och det är en rejäl nedskrivning. Men man justerar ner prognosen rejält."*

---

### ⛔ EVO — Evolution | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

~9% Brazil exposure (JP Morgan estimate), with studios and infrastructure built there; flagged as a mover today.

#### Reasoning

The exposure figure is JP Morgan's estimate, not the hosts' own. Evolution has invested in Brazilian studios and infrastructure that could be stranded if the ban holds. The hosts expect gaming stocks to take a big hit.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the ban is only temporary or dropped after the 4 October election
- if Evolution quantifies a small impact

> *"Evolution hade också en stor andel, det var 9 %, det var JP Morgan som var ute och bedömde."*

---

### 🟠 KAMBI — Kambi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Low single-digit revenue from Brazil, so a limited direct hit, but the Brazil growth story disappears.

#### Reasoning

Kambi only works in regulated markets and was expecting Brazil to become a growth driver. The start there was slow, so the direct revenue loss is small, but a ban would remove the growth option.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Brazil's ban becomes permanent

> *"Inte samma smäll där men tillväxtstoryn uteblir."*

---

### 🟠 BETS-B — Betsson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Latin America is a growth market for Betsson; exposed to the Brazil ban, though it does well in Peru and Colombia.

#### Reasoning

Hosts say Betsson has performed well in Latin America but did not quantify its Brazil exposure. It is exposed to the same Brazil ban risk as the others.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Brazil ban spreads to other Latin American markets

> *"Även Betsson snackar väl om att Latinamerika är en tillväxtmarknad."*

---

### 🟠 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

US tariff cuts on Chinese household appliances could raise competition from cheaper imports.

#### Reasoning

As part of the US-China deal, the US is cutting tariffs on household appliances. The hosts say this could hurt Electrolux in the US market because Chinese imports would become cheaper. They framed it as speculative ('eventuellt').

#### Sell Triggers

- if the tariff cuts leave out large appliances

> *"vilket eventuellt då skulle kunna slå mot bolag som Electrolux om det blir billigare att importera kinesiska varor istället"*

---
